nom: NEOGEN Real Bio Peel Gauze Peeling Green Tea Pad

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, bump-prone cheeks found the pads effective for gentle exfoliation without irritation.
segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers describe sensitive skin, including rosacea, eczema and dermatitis, and report the pads exfoliate without triggering irritation, though one warns the coarse side can feel too harsh for sensitive skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry combination skin reports even skin brightness and moisture alongside exfoliation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky or dehydrated skin report the pads remove dead skin and leave skin soft without over-exfoliating or raw skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s and 70s report smoother, less rough and wrinkly-feeling skin with regular use.

concerns.aging: One 49-year-old reports rough, wrinkly texture improving after 7 uses; a 71-year-old describes it as a nice treat that leaves skin looking and feeling better.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dehydrated or dry skin report increased softness and hydration after use, with one noting moisture alongside exfoliation.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports temporary pinkness that resolves by morning; another with dermatitis reports the green tea helps minimize redness and irritation.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema report the pads remove dry, flaky skin without causing further irritation or leaving skin raw.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product keeps acne at bay; another credits it with helping reduce acne scars and black/whiteheads, though a third mentions occasional monthly breakouts persisting.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the pads minimize breakouts; another describes ongoing occasional monthly breakouts despite regular use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports fewer bumps and improved texture on the cheeks after use.

aspects.libelle: Green tea scent pleasant and mild
Results fade after a couple days

extraits.texte: I unfortunately have incredibly sensitive skin that is often very red and dry due to rosacea. I have to be very careful about what I use on my face. I'd been trying to find an exfoliant that would remove dry skin but not irritate my skin for quite some time and decided to take a change on the bio-peel. I'm so glad I did! I've been using this product for about a month now and my skin look and feels so good! I use them no more than once a week and although my skin gets pink after use, by the morning its gone. The green tea scent is really lovely (I'm picky about scents) and smells so refreshing. If you have sensitive skin I 100% recommend these.

I was nervous about using this because I have eczema and anything can set it off on my face. I couldn't believe that this didn't irritate my skin and removed the dead skin without over-exfoliating and leaving my skin raw.

I love this stuff. It might be a little bit pricey, but I cut the pads in half. My skin looks and feels better. There's a nice tingly feeling, and a glow that lasts a couple of days. It's a nice extra treat for my 71-year-old skin. Highly recommend.

I have extremely dry flaky sensitive skin with occasional monthly breakouts. I only have to use this once a week and it leaves my skin incredibly smooth. It?셲 really gentle on my skin too. I use both sides as one side is coarse and the other is smooth. It?셲 quickly become my favorite exfoliator

I have dry, sensitive, dehydrated skin with aging concerns. I fell in love with this product and will never be without it, ever. This is the most soothing and refreshing exfoliation product I've ever used. It's not harsh but it's definitely effective. I can't say enough about Green Tea Bio-Peel. I just turned 49 and my skin was getting that rough and wrinkly texture. I tried other exfoliating products but they were harsh and took a long time for my sensitive skin to heal. Tried this one and first thing I noticed was no burning, then how soft my skin felt. After 7 uses the texture of my skin is so soft and smooth. There's definitely an improvement. After using this on my face in the shower I use the pads on my arms and knees and anywhere I think I need extra help that week. This is just awesome. Going to try the Micro Essence and Serum next. Thanks for making such a life changing product.

I ordered these and the red wine ones at the same time since my skin is tricky and I need different effects depending on my skin's condition when I use them. What's noticable first is the scent, a very mild and pleasing fragrance. Used twice a week, I could see a visibly even skin brightness, and my dry combination skin loves the exfoliation + moisture. Can't recommend these enough. I feel like they help my hyperpigmentation but that could also be the Vitamin C serum
It you have sensitive, it could be a little too harsh on the skin, but I love that it has two side. One is soft and smooth while the other side is more for exfoliating and sort of rough on the skin.
